correctness.rationale: Starting from independent uniform priorities, the one-vertex occupancy probability is derived by a conditional first-neighbor differential recurrence and an exact integral, independently checked by first-arrival recursion on sizes up to nine. Exact maximal-set enumeration on sizes up to ten independently verifies the Padovan formula. A proof for all lengths at least twenty-three uses strict rational bounds for plastic root, Padovan ratios and alternating exponential remainders; exact finite-size sign enumeration closes lengths fourteen through twenty-two, with a central-position counterexample at length thirteen proving sharpness. The standalone checker executes 289 exact rational assertions. The theorem is about one-point marginals only.

originality.rationale: The exact sequential and static site-probability formulas are established in prior work and are explicitly credited. The new assertion is not those formulas, or the previously proved total-count dominance, but a strict sign classification for every vertex of every path of length at least fourteen, with the sharp onset. It requires a uniform factorial-tail and plastic-number comparison, not a direct consequence of stochastic order of totals. Six actual published-record semantic searches, primary full-text comparisons, and a targeted study of nearby published results did not identify the same implication. An inaccessible earlier 2026 article and unindexed results are residual priority risks.
residual_risks: Earlier related 2026 Statistical & Probability Letters article DOI 10.1016/j.spl.2026.110682 remained inaccessible in full.
Pre-2017 or unindexed sitewise comparative inequalities may exist; a query cannot establish absolute novelty.
Novelty is the sharp comparative sign classification, not separate preexisting marginal formulas or total count order.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 theorem establishes global total-size stochastic dominance of random greedy parking over uniform maximal independent sets on paths. A common but invalid inference is sitewise improvement. The new theorem demonstrates a persistent exactly four-site reversal at every sufficiently long path, classifying which finite positions lose occupation probability despite global dominance and proving the sharp onset. Local occupancy is the meaningful node-throughput observable in CSMA networks, documented by the 2017 original. The all-length strict sign classification needs substantial analytic comparison beyond merely computing a few small examples.
